records.rule: Draft a chapter only after its architecture prerequisites are accepted. Later integrative chapters may depend on earlier technical chapters, while the introduction and abstract are finalized only after results and conclusions stabilize.

CONTEXT.md governs domain terminology and claim boundaries. The notation register governs manuscript symbols. A chapter may introduce local shorthand only when it records the mapping and does not change the domain meaning.

Classify each statement before drafting as repository-derived, externally dependent, quantitative, or interpretive. Link repository-derived claims to their canonical evidence entry; add primary external sources and BibTeX keys for externally dependent claims; generate quantitative statements from accepted artifacts; then review the nearby citation for scope before changing its review state.

Every manuscript table and quantitative figure is generated from an accepted versioned artifact or independently reconciled to one. Generated assets live under manuscript/generated, carry a stable claim-register ID and source identity, are never hand-edited after generation, and are rebuilt before a release. Candidate-created conceptual diagrams must identify their governing claims and remain distinct from empirical figures.

Record each dated supervisor concern in supervisor-feedback.json with its source, affected locations, classification, decision, owner, resolution evidence, and verification state. Editorial feedback may update the manuscript; any request that changes frozen science, data, parameters, hypotheses, or registered inference opens separately tracked research instead of silently revising accepted evidence.

The manuscript moves only through structural-shell, chapter-draft, integrated-draft, review-candidate, supervisor-candidate, and submission-candidate. Each transition requires all mandatory controls for that state, a clean canonical build, current evidence and notation registers, regenerated assets, and the reviews assigned by the effort map. Submission-candidate additionally requires every institutional blocker and supervisor feedback item to be resolved.
